class DelegationTransferToken55 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
function DelegationLeaf55($token) {
    echo 'CHILD|';
    try {
        $received = Fiber::suspend('pause55');
        echo 'CHILD-RESUMED|', (int) ($received === 'resume55'), '|';
        yield 'child55';
        return 71;
    } finally {
        echo 'CHILD-FINALLY|';
    }
}
function DelegationParent55($child, $token) {
    global $given;
    echo 'PARENT|';
    try {
        $returned = yield from $child;
        echo 'CHILD-RETURN|', (int) ($returned === 71), '|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'PARENT-CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        echo (int) ($caught->getPrevious() === null), '|';
        echo (int) ($caught->getMessage() === 'supplied55'), '|';
    } finally {
        echo 'PARENT-FINALLY|';
    }
    yield 'parent55';
    echo 'PARENT-END|';
    return 72;
}
$given = new Exception('supplied55');
$token = new DelegationTransferToken55();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$child = DelegationLeaf55($token);
$parent = DelegationParent55($child, $token);
unset($child, $token);
$f = new Fiber(function () {
    global $parent;
    echo 'FIBER|';
    $current = $parent->current();
    echo 'CURRENT|', (int) ($current === 'parent55'), '|';

echo 'START|', $f->start(), '|';

echo 'INJECT|';
$reply = $f->throw($given);
echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER-DONE|', (int) $f->isTerminated(), '|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber55'), '|';
echo 'LIVE|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$parent->next();
echo 'PARENT-DONE|', (int) $parent->valid(), '|', (int) ($parent->getReturn() === 72), '|';
echo 'DROPPED|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
echo 'GIVEN|', (int) ($given->getPrevious() === null), '|';
